title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification

clauses.title: Grading Zones for Fine Aggregates (Sand Zones I, II, III, IV)
clauses.text: Clause 5.1 & Table 4 (Fine Aggregate Grading Zones): Fine aggregate (sand) is classified into four grading zones based on percentage passing 600-micron sieve: Zone I (Coarse Sand) = 15% to 34% passing; Zone II (Medium Sand) = 35% to 59% passing; Zone III (Fine Sand) = 60% to 79% passing; Zone IV (Very Fine Sand) = 80% to 100% passing. Zone IV shall not be used in reinforced concrete unless approved.

clauses.title: Crushing Value, Impact Value & Abrasion Limits for Coarse Aggregate
clauses.text: Clause 6.1 & Table 1 (Physical Limits for Coarse Aggregate): (1) Aggregate Crushing Value: Max 30% for concrete wearing surfaces (roads/runways) and max 45% for other structures. (2) Aggregate Impact Value (AIV): Max 30% for wearing surfaces and max 45% for other concrete. (3) Los Angeles Abrasion: Max 30% for wearing surfaces and max 50% for others. (4) Flakiness and Elongation Index combined: Max 40%.
